newsitem.title: USA: Xytronyx Inc appoints new CEO and president.
newsitem.headline: Xytronyx Inc appoints new CEO and president.

text.p: Xytronyx Inc said Thursday it hired H. Laurence Shaw to serve as the company's new chief executive officer and president, and that it had closed on a net amount of $2,910,150 in an initial closing of its private placement.
The proceeds received in the initial closing will allow the company to continue as a going concern into 1997, a statement from the company said.
Larry Bymaster, the present CEO and president, will take on a new position with the primary responsibility of overseeing the company's PTM and Kephra product lines.
Prior to joining the company, Shaw served as corporate vice president research development of C.R. Bard, the statement said.

The company intends to use the proceeds from the private placement for the payment of accrued liabilities, completion of preclinical development of its cancer therapies, working capital for general corporate purposes and for the repayment of certain indebtedness, the statement said.
